title: BA Planner animation spectrum v1
description: One character per file. Animation callbacks and logic effects remain separate layers on a 30 fps logic axis. Shape validation does not prove source mappings or arithmetic relationships.

characterId.description: The existing CharacterExcel integer ID; use its decimal representation as the character filename.

ko.description: Verified Korean name, or an empty string when unavailable.

ja.description: Verified Japanese name, or an empty string when unavailable.

path.description: Client-relative containing bundle path, matching clip.bundlePath.

sourceFps.description: Original clip sampling rate; this does not replace the 30 fps logic conversion rate.

lengthSeconds.description: Observed motion clip length in seconds, independent of logic Duration.

logicDurationFrames.description: Separately verified raw logic Duration, or null when the correspondence is unknown. Preserve signed sentinels such as -1 and 2147483647 and explain them in event notes; never use them to replace the clip length.

events.description: Logic effects may continue beyond the motion clip length; do not clamp them to it.

frame.description: round(timeSeconds * 30), using Python ties-to-even rounding, independently of sourceFps.

estimated.description: True when abs(timeSeconds * 30 - frame) >= 0.5 frames or the basis, including the callback's category/meaning, is inferred. Small source float errors alone do not require true.

note.description: Explain inference, unknown source mappings, unavailable rowSha/rva, and any preserved logic Duration sentinel. An observed callback is not proof of damage or a Torment skill mapping.

kind.description: Matches the diagram tags [표], [코드], [관측], [지식], [?], respectively. This labels the source; estimated separately records inference.

table.description: Verified table/row location. Multiple verified location types may coexist.

clipPath.description: Verified catalog clip path, or a containing bundle plus observed AnimationClip object name and PathID locator. Do not invent a catalog address.

rowSha.description: Original row SHA-256, present only when actually known.

rva.description: Verified code RVA as a hexadecimal string, present only when actually known.
